title: Review completion signal v1.1.0
description: Written once by the native reviewer session to <run>/review.completion.json. The controller accepts it only when it validates here, its bindings match the run (run_id, review node, launch_token from the reviewer prompt, bundle SHA-256 and candidate commit from review-bundle.json) and the reviewer session is idle or done. A verdict of blocked, or any P0/P1 finding that is not resolved, ends the run; no second reviewer is launched. 1.1.0: a finding's `worker` is a lane id of the run (`^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$`), `multiple` or `none`; the controller additionally rejects a lane id the run did not select. The legacy `both` is not accepted any more. Files spelling version 1.0.0 are still accepted under the same rules.

worker.description: The lane whose assignment the finding concerns (one of the run's selected lane ids), `multiple` when it concerns several lanes, or `none` for cross-cutting/policy findings. Never `both` and never a fixed graph node name.

requirement.description: A verbatim quote from that lane's task text that the finding relates to, or null when no single requirement applies. Consumers link a finding to its task only when the quote is found verbatim; nothing is inferred.
